technical.subTitle: My primary stack is Python — FastAPI and Django on the backend, paired with PostgreSQL, Redis, and RabbitMQ for data and messaging layers. I've built and shipped production systems on both Azure and AWS, including Dockerised deployments with CI/CD pipelines, observability stacks, and async task processing with Celery. I'm equally comfortable on the frontend with React and Next.js when the work calls for it.

section1.title: Polymath Foundations
section1.copy: My background spans data analytics, backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and AI integration — from building RAG pipelines with pgvector and Qdrant to prototyping AWS Bedrock embeddings for unstructured data classification. That breadth gives me a systems-level perspective that purely specialised engineers often miss.

section2.title: Software I love to work with
section2.copy: I thrive on developing user-centric digital products that not only perform flawlessly but also offer a delightful user experience. Drawing on my experience with diverse projects at MaxRetail and beyond, I've learned to appreciate the art of great software design. Whether it's a robust API or a dynamic front-end dashboard, I enjoy dissecting the architecture of successful applications to drive intuitive, high-performance solutions.

section3.title: Technologies I love to build with
section3.copy: Python, FastAPI, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, React, Next.js, AWS, Azure, Docker, GitHub Actions, Celery, SQLAlchemy, TypeScript
